Name: Grandma's Pantry
Author: siberiandoctor
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
[b]Grandma’s Pantry[/b] is a cozy story-and-items mod about the farmer’s grandmother.
In the original game, Grandpa is an important part of the farmer’s story, but Grandma is barely mentioned. This mod tries to give her a small place in the world of Stardew Valley through letters, memories, homemade recipes, and warm pantry goods.
The mod adds new items, recipes, shop content, letters, and small story moments connected to Grandma’s forgotten kitchen legacy.
I have fully checked the mod on my side, and everything should work correctly. The mod is designed to be compatible with other mods and major Stardew Valley expansions, since it is made through Content Patcher and does not replace vanilla files directly. If you find any bugs, conflicts, mistakes, or broken text, please let me know so I can fix them.
[heading]Installation instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b].[/*]
[*]Install [b]Content Patcher[/b].[/*]
[*]Download the mod archive.[/*]
[*]Extract the mod folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][heading]Main features[/heading]
[list]
[*]A small story about Grandma and her forgotten kitchen legacy.[/*]
[*]New homemade pantry items.[/*]
[*]New recipes.[/*]
[*]New letters.[/*]
[*]New shop entries.[/*]
[*]Small story moments and discoveries.[/*]
[*]Cozy Russian text and atmosphere.[/*]
[*]Designed to work alongside other mods and major expansions.[/*]
[*]Content Patcher-based implementation, no vanilla files are replaced directly.[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[/list]The mod is currently written only in Russian.
